source.scope: Cross-check of the nine finfish-group source entries only. Current name status does not re-identify source specimens, establish Benguet occurrence, or validate local/common names.

method.queryMethod: Reviewed current species-name records and the genus listing for Lentipes; retained the exact record URLs below.
limitations: Catalog status supports nomenclature, not identification of the Amburayan specimens.
A species distribution summary is contextual evidence for review prioritization, not a complete range polygon or absence test.
No vouchers, specimens, DNA barcodes, identification certificates or separate local expert determination were examined in this cross-check.

resultSummary.interpretation: Eight candidate binomials correspond to current valid Catalog usages, including two source spelling inconsistencies. The ninth fish entry remains Rhinogobius sp.; no species is inferred from that genus-only label. All names remain source-identification claims pending specimen-level review.

disposition.reason: The Catalog supports current name status for candidate names, not specimen identity. Two source spelling issues and the Lentipes armatus locality anomaly need explicit follow-up; Rhinogobius remains genus-only.

nextAction: Seek specimen numbers, diagnostic photographs, identification certificates or author clarification for the Amburayan fish entries, prioritizing the Lentipes armatus Benguet locality and the G. affinis spelling. Keep all candidate names linked to the verbatim article labels; do not admit rows without the source-reuse, location and specimen gates.
